variants.title: Loading effect of an oscilloscope input (1 megohm)
variants.unknown: the input resistance of a 1 megohm scope input
variants.note: A scope's direct input is 1 megohm in parallel with a few tens of picofarads; a 10x probe raises the resistance to 10 megohm. Only the resistance matters at DC. Typical class value, not one model.

source.title: Typical oscilloscope input: 1 megohm (Tektronix, XYZs of Oscilloscopes primer)

variants.title: Loading effect of an analogue multimeter (20 kilohm per volt)
variants.sample: Analogue multimeter on its 5 V range, 20 kilohm per volt
variants.unknown: the input resistance of an analogue meter on the 5 V range
variants.note: An analogue meter's input resistance is its ohms-per-volt sensitivity times the range: 20 kilohm per volt on 5 V is 100 kilohm. Typical class value, not one model.

source.title: Ohms-per-volt sensitivity of a moving-coil voltmeter: input resistance = sensitivity x range (standard instrumentation textbooks)
